name: Financial Support Scheme
briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to financially weak students of the University of Delhi to help them overcome financial challenges and continue their education without hardship.
descriptionMd: The Department of Distance & Education, School of Open Learning, Campus of Open Learning (DDCE/SOL/COL), in the spirit of facilitating financially weak students as per guidelines decided by the University of Delhi, has announced the Financial Support Scheme for DDCE/SOL/COL students. This scheme is reflected through a fee waiver/refund for the students enrolled in DDCE/SOL/COL and having their family income below the poverty line. The fee waiver/refund includes all components of the fee paid by students except the examination fee and the university fee.
benefitsMd: **S. No.****Family income (in ₹) per annum****Fee waiver (percentage)****Remarks**Category 1Less than or equal to ₹ 4,00,000/Up to 100%Actual fee or up to a maximum of ₹ 15000/-Category 2Between ₹ 4,00,000/- and ₹ 8,00,000/-Up to 50%Actual fee or up to a maximum of ₹ 10,000/-
eligibilityMd: - A full-time bonafide student studying in any UG/PG Program in a department/institute/center of the University of Delhi (UoD). - The family income of the student should be less than ₹ 8,00,000/-. - Students enrolled in constituent colleges of UoD. - B.Tech Programs (excluding CIC) Five-year integrated LAW programs, SoL and NCWEB are NOT eligible.
exclusionsMd: - 2nd, 3rd & 4th year candidates with ER/Arrears of previous examination papers are not eligible to apply.
applicationMd: **Step 1:** Eligible students can fill in the online [application form](https://fss.oldcdu.ac.in/) available on the website of the Dean's Students’ Welfare Office. **Step 2:** Students must submit a copy of their application form and all documents after due attestation and recommendation from the head/director of the concerned department/center/institute at DSW office. **Step 3:** The schedule for the submission of the hard/printed copy of the application form will be declared in the DSW website. > ***Helpdesk:*** For any queries kindly contact: fss@dsw.du.ac.in > ***Office Address:*** Dean Students’ Welfare, Conference Centre (Gate No. 4), Opposite Botany Department, University of Delhi, Delhi – 110007
